title: NFCPS One 1.8.14 Watch Together Links
notes: Watch Together now uses the NFCPS Watch-style movie frame, remembers an active room so it can be continued later, and shares verified NFCPS One HTTPS room links. On Android 1.8.14, installed NFCPS One can open those links directly into the matching Cinema room; otherwise the same link falls back to the web app.
